### `test/radial_sound`

The node convention driven by a song: signed radius is a breathing base ring plus per-band petal harmonics, with bass-onset detection triggering a fast 180 deg orientation flip and an outward size pulse per beat.

### `test/spectral_falls`

The earlier audio waterfall, superseded by the stack: x is log frequency, so melodies visibly slide their peaks; every 0.42 s the live top ridge freezes and scrolls down, twenty-four ridges fading with age.
